Situation Report — Day 27

Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. Tactical: this follows a first 5‑day pause that was violated hours later by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.

  • Other international moves: Large drone attack reported on St. Petersburg (Russia). Reports that Turkey's new Somalia spaceport doubles as a missile range. Houthis continued activity versus Saudi airspace. Russia publicly denies intentions to attack Europe.
  • Security concerns: Reports allege Israeli planning to target Iranian negotiators; US reportedly warned Iran. Hamas reportedly executed Gazan accused of collaboration. These actions raise risks to negotiations and civilian protection.
